title: Fast vs. real-time export
desc: Fast — frame-accurate (default) Each output frame is built from the exact source frames and encoded directly, and audio is mixed offline.…
k: Exporting Fast — frame-accurate (default) Real-time Fast — frame-accurate (default) Each output frame is built from the exact source frames and encoded directly, and audio is mixed offline. It is usually many times faster than real time and gives the exact duration. Real-time The sequence is played and recorded, so a 5-minute edit takes 5 minutes.

desc: Reelsmith saves a recovery copy of your work a moment after every change. If the app quits unexpectedly, the next start offers Restore.…
k: Projects & Saving Reelsmith saves a recovery copy of your work a moment after every change. If the app quits unexpectedly, the next start offers Restore. Choose it to continue where you left off, then save the project normally. Closing the app normally clears the recovery copy.
